acceptance_criteria.criterion: The system must autonomously handle review loops without manual intervention.
The system must log all actions and decisions for auditability.
The system must enforce budget constraints as per configuration.

e2e_flows.title: Autonomous Review Loop Execution
steps: Claude picks up an assignment from the queue.
Claude writes a review pack and submits it.
e2e_flows.pass_condition: The review pack is processed without errors and logged.
e2e_flows.fail_condition: The review pack processing fails or logs an error.

e2e_flows.title: Budget Enforcement
steps: GPT checks the budget before starting work.
GPT logs usage after each API call.
GPT alerts if budget thresholds are exceeded.
e2e_flows.pass_condition: Budget alerts are triggered correctly when thresholds are exceeded.
e2e_flows.fail_condition: Budget alerts fail to trigger when thresholds are exceeded.

e2e_flows.title: Audit Log Verification
steps: Boss reviews the audit log for a completed assignment.
Boss verifies all actions and decisions are logged.
Boss confirms the log matches expected actions.
e2e_flows.pass_condition: All actions and decisions are present and correct in the log.
e2e_flows.fail_condition: Missing or incorrect entries in the audit log.

uat_scenarios.description: Verify autonomous handling of review loops.

test_cases.rationale: Claude should autonomously handle the assignment.
Review pack submission should be autonomous.
System should not require manual intervention.

uat_scenarios.description: Verify logging of actions and decisions.

test_cases.rationale: All actions should be logged.
All decisions should be logged.
No log entries should be missing.
Calls within budget should proceed.
Calls exceeding budget should be blocked.
Alerts should trigger when budget is exceeded.

requirements.requirement: The system must connect to MongoDB using a secure connection string stored as an environment variable.
The system must log all emergency triggers to MongoDB Safety.emergency_incidents.
The system must display provider locations on an embedded Google Map within the chat interface.
The system must use Angular for the frontend, hosted on Cloudflare Pages.
The system must return up to 10 providers per query, filtered by state and optionally by city.

e2e_flows.title: User searches for a provider
steps: User enters a natural language query for a healthcare provider.
System maps the query to NPI taxonomy codes.
System returns matching providers in the chat interface.
e2e_flows.pass_condition: Providers are displayed in the chat interface.
e2e_flows.fail_condition: No providers are displayed or an error message is shown.

e2e_flows.title: Safety filter escalation
steps: User mentions a keyword indicating an emergency.
System logs the incident and escalates appropriately.
e2e_flows.fail_condition: Incident is not logged or escalated.

e2e_flows.title: Angular frontend rendering
steps: Angular frontend loads and displays the chat interface.
User interacts with the chat interface.
e2e_flows.pass_condition: Chat interface loads and functions correctly.
e2e_flows.fail_condition: Chat interface fails to load or has functional issues.
